mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_wishlist.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO wishlist ( wishlist_no, member_no, product_no, created_at ) VALUES ( #{wishlistNo}, #{memberNo}, #{productNo}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT w.wishlist_no AS wishlistNo, w.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn, w.created_at AS wishedAt FROM wishlist w JOIN product p ON p.product_no = w.product_no LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE w.member_no = #{memberNo} AND p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY w.created_at DESC, w.wishlist_no DESC
